task: Lossless serialization of graph-walk node IDs on two graphs with about 317k–335k nodes. A first round of 4096 length-80 uniform-transition walks estimates frequencies; four subsequent rounds are encoded. Minimize total encoded bytes including framing and one inverse rank dictionary where needed. No latency objective.

methods.packed: Encode dense IDs using fixed-width 19-bit packing; framing and lengths included, no frequency dictionary.
methods.rank_varint: Sort IDs by first-round frequency, remap to integer ranks, encode ranks with unsigned LEB128, and charge one uint32 inverse dictionary for all graph nodes across the four encoded rounds.

metric: total serialized bytes, lower is better
unknowns: No empirical frequency histogram or encoded byte measurements supplied.

task: Two exposed small-VLM still-image attention traces, 64 visual tokens grouped into eight contiguous windows. Assign exactly two FP16, three INT4 and three INT2 windows; first window stays FP16. Use only prefill information to choose windows; evaluate subsequent decode attention output relative L2. Quantizer and resident budget matched; ranking overhead not measured.

methods.softmax: Rank windows by exact prefill text-to-visual attention softmax mass, averaged over query heads/tokens.
methods.onebit: Rank windows by prefill mean raw query-key logits approximated using one-bit keys, averaged over heads/tokens.

metric: mean decode attention-output relative L2, lower is better
unknowns: No trace values, quantization-error distributions or measured output errors supplied.

task: Offline replay of real Cora two-layer GCN hidden embeddings with four random graph partitions, warmup20 and sync every4 epochs. Two development seeds choose rate from .1,1,10 and fixed weight from 0,.25,.5,.75,1; two separate seeds screen both constant learning rate and a prespecified x.1 learning-rate drop. Same predictor state, boundary pairs and sync budgets in every arm.

methods.predictor: Always use a self-fed damped linear-trend predictor; exponential slope accumulator and damping rates .2. Warmup observes real values; stale predictions update predictor state.
methods.gate: Convex mixture of that predictor and separate last-observed hold, with one Fixed Share weight per directed partition pair. Start weights .5/.5, share .01. Update only from grouped squared relative endpoint errors when synchronization reveals truth; predict before observation. Development selects the rate. Intermediate truth is evaluator-only.

metric: mean relative L2 stale embedding error across screening seeds, lower is better
unknowns: No embedding trajectories, measured operator losses or validation scores supplied.
